title: Ancient DNA Extraction from Osteological Samples
author: E-Jean Tan

steps.title: Pre‑treat sample with EDTA
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 0.5 M EDTA to each osteological sample in a 2‑mL screw‑cap tube.

steps.title: Prepare Yang‑urea lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Mix for 10 samples: 8.35 mL 0.5 M EDTA (final 0.42 M), 1.25 mL 8 M urea (final 1 M), and 0.4 mL 10 mg mL⁻¹ Proteinase K (final 0.4 mg mL⁻¹). For bone powder adjust Proteinase K to a final 0.2 mg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the Yang‑urea lysis buffer to each sample (including extraction blanks). Incubate with rotation at 55 °C for 3–6 h (alternatively 37 °C for 16–24 h). Store crude extracts at –20 °C until purification.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Quick‑spin the tubes, then add 40 µL of 10 mg mL⁻¹ Proteinase K to each sample. Incubate with rotation at 37 °C overnight (16–24 h). Crude extracts and blanks may be stored at –20 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge crude extracts
steps.instruction: If extracts were frozen, thaw completely. Place tubes in a microcentrifuge and spin at 12 000 rpm for 5 min (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Spin down and discard EDTA
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the oven, quick‑spin to collect liquid from lids and walls, then aspirate and discard the EDTA solution.

steps.title: Create extraction blank (EB)
steps.instruction: Prepare a new 2‑mL screw‑cap tube for each blank and add 1 mL of EDTA. Use one EB per 10 samples (e.g., 3 EBs for 25 samples). Treat EB like a regular sample throughout the workflow.

steps.title: Hybridisation oven incubation and EDTA removal
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a rotary hybridisation oven and incubate with rotation at 37 °C for 30 min (for bone powder, 15 min). Centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 1 min, then carefully remove and discard the EDTA without disturbing the bone powder.

steps.title: Optional second digestion and combine extracts
steps.instruction: If digestion is incomplete, quick‑spin, transfer the crude extract to a new 2‑mL DNA LoBind tube and store at –20 °C. Add fresh 1 mL Yang‑urea lysis buffer, incubate at 55 °C for 2–6 h (or until complete digestion). Store the second extract at –20 °C, then combine both supernatants (≈2 mL total) for downstream processing.

steps.title: Concentrate supernatant with Amicon filter
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to an Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter. Centrifuge in a swing‑bucket centrifuge at 2000 × g for 20 min (temperature not specified) until the retentate volume is 100–150 µL. Repeat centrifugation if necessary. Store the remaining pellet/debris at –20 °C for possible re‑extraction.

steps.title: Add Buffer PB to retentate
steps.instruction: Using a 200‑µL extended‑length tip, transfer the retentate to a new 2‑mL DNA LoBind tube. Add 10× volume of Buffer PB, mix by pipetting up and down, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Load onto MinElute column
steps.instruction: Transfer the retentate‑PB mixture (~600 µL) onto a MinElute spin column. Centrifuge at 12 000 rpm for 1 min, discard the flow‑through, and repeat until the entire mixture has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Place the MinElute column into a new collection tube and wash with 720 µL Buffer PE. Centrifuge at 12 000 rpm for 1 min.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column again at 12 000 rpm for 1 min to eliminate residual ethanol.

steps.title: First elution with Buffer EB
steps.instruction: Place the column in a clean 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube (no lid). Add 55 µL Buffer EB drop‑wise to the centre of the membrane, incubate at 37 °C for 5 min, then centrifuge at 12 000 rpm for 1 min.

steps.title: Collect eluate and store
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate (~110 µL) to a new 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube, label with sample ID, DNA extract, and date, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Second elution with Buffer EB
steps.instruction: Add another 55 µL Buffer EB drop‑wise to the same column, incubate at 37 °C for 5 min, and centrifuge at 12 000 rpm for 1 min. Collect the second eluate as above.
